title: Biased Boolean probability mass function
statement: For $p\in[0,1]$, take a sign with the biased sign probability mass function at parameter $p$ and map it to a Boolean value that is true exactly when the sign is $-1$. The resulting probability mass function on Boolean values is the biased Boolean probability mass function at parameter $p$.
